verdict.rationale: Brave's Answers endpoint returns AI-generated answers grounded in real-time web search with verifiable sources. It does so through a single OpenAI-compatible call, which covers the core of the story. However, inline citation tags are documented only with stream=true and are not supported in research mode, so sourcing is limited. The separate summarizer path also needs two calls (a web search, then a summary key). missing for 10: citations in non-streaming single responses, citations in research mode, independent or hands-on corroboration that single-call sourced answers work as claimed.

support.subject: As a developer, I can get a sourced, LLM-generated answer to a query in a single API call
